titles.display: Tama Art University Library

extract: Tama Art University Library is the academic library associated with Tama Art University consisting of two library locations in Tokyo, Japan: one on the Hachioji campus and the other on the Kaminoge campus. Together, the libraries serve university students and faculty. The primary focus is on art education and research. Its collection also includes database materials on design, architecture, film, photography, and other related topics of study.
